Hi Markus / Ben,

We're ready to lock the annual prepay for 2027 but need a clear activation / drawdown schedule and what VAT evidence you need from us for EU billing. Procurement also asked for a sample invoice number format so they can map it to the PO.

Can you:
- Share the proposed phased activation windows (we plan to enable usage across three product teams staggered over Q1)
- Confirm first-invoice timing relative to the activation (invoice upon activation vs fixed start date)
- Tell us what VAT documents you require for the Netherlands entity (we have the VAT certificate ready)
- Attach a sample invoice PDF we can show finance/procurement

I've attached our PO as a starting point (PO_Lynx_2027.pdf).

Thanks,
Samantha

Hi Samantha — thanks for sending the PO and the heads-up. High level plan below; Ben and Evelyn are looped for invoicing and tax details.

Proposed phased activation windows (suggested):
- Phase 1 (Pilot): activate accounts up to 20% of committed capacity — target date: 2027-01-03
- Phase 2 (Scale): enable additional teams to 60% total capacity — target date: 2027-02-01
- Phase 3 (Full): all teams live (100%) — target date: 2027-03-01

Billing approach options (pick one):
1) Invoice on activation: we issue the prepay invoice when Phase 1 is activated, then ladder subsequent invoices at Phase 2/Phase 3.
2) Invoice upfront: single annual invoice on a fixed start date (we can align to 2027-01-01).

Ben — can you attach the sample invoice numbering and a stub? Evelyn — flag any EU VAT evidence we should request for the Netherlands entity and whether reverse-charge applies.

I will also push the SOW via DocuSign after we agree timelines.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha — received the VAT certificate, thanks. A few clarifications from finance: 

- Billing/legal entity: Redwood Inference Ltd (UK) will be the invoicing entity for this contract.
- VAT handling: for B2B EU customers with valid NL VAT numbers, we typically apply reverse-charge — the invoice will show VAT as 0% with a reverse-charge note, provided the VAT ID validates.
- Timing: we can accommodate the Phase 1 invoice on 2027-02-01.

Required evidence we need before issuing invoice (please upload to the shared drive or reply here):
- Registered VAT number and certificate (we have the cert you attached)
- Billing address for the NL entity
- PO number that matches invoice header (we will use PO_Lynx_2027.pdf reference)

Attachments: VAT-evidence-country-list.xlsx (shows documents we request per country), banking-instructions.txt (remit details follow once invoice issued).

Once we have the billing address and PO confirmation, Ben/Markus — we can finalize the invoice schedule and send the DocuSign SOW.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
